name: bld6_sum_fixed_points_sub_one_sq_perm
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) : ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => σ i = i)).card : ℤ) - 1) ^ 2 = (n.factorial : ℤ)
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n), ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => σ i = i)).card : ℤ) - 1) ^ 2 = (n.factorial : ℤ)
informal: Uses Mathlib2.calc_sum_sq_card_fixed_points_perm and Mathlib2.calc_sum_card_fixed_points_perm: expand (X - 1)^2 = X^2 - 2X + 1 and sum over the n! permutations: 2·n! (second moment, calc_sum_sq_card_fixed_points_perm) - 2·n! (first moment, calc_sum_card_fixed_points_perm) + n! (Fintype.card_perm) — the number of fixed points of a random permutation has variance 1.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), 2 ≤ n → ∑ σ, (↑{i | σ i = i}.card - 1) ^ 2 = ↑n.factorial
